quotes.text: Upon termination of a run, it receives the full interaction trajectory alongside the rubric packet.
shifts evaluation from outcome-only judgement to process-level assessment

parsed.rationale: The grader is an LLM judge reading the full trajectory, with a stated process-level rationale. Validation is by clinician ratings on 100 runs, without evaluator-versus-label per-class error rates on injected or labelled correct and incorrect outcomes, so element (iii) is not met.
